title: R&D Test Automation Engineer - India Development Centre

title: QA Engineer II
desc: We’re not your traditional tech company and we don’t aim to be. Going against the grain is in our DNA. Building a revolutionary product begins with revolutionary thinking. That’s why we value diversity of thought, background and lived experience. Together, we empower restaurants of all sizes to build great teams, increase revenue, improve operations, and delight their guests. We pair our deep understanding of the restaurant industry with powerful cloud based software and restaurant-grade hardware to deliver an intuitive all-in-one platform. Join us on our mission to empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.  We are Toasters Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success.At Toast our employees are our secret ingredient. When they are powered to succeed, Toast succeeds. The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse industries. We embrace and are excited by this diversity, believing that only through authenticity, inclusivity, high standards of respect and trust, and leading with humility will we be able to achieve our goals. Baking inclusive principles into our company and diversity into our design provides equitable opportunities for all and enhances our ability to be first in class in all aspects of our industry. Toast is named as One of the Best Places to Work in 2024 by Glassdoor. Are you bready* for a change? Toast is scaling rapidly and with that growth comes an exciting new opportunity to join one of our earliest and impactful lines of business in Bangalore. Toast is looking for a ​Quality Assurance Engineer to join its FinTech Integrated Payments team that enables our International customers & Enterprise integrations. You will enable restaurants by playing a critical role in testing features in this domain.The Toast platform processes tens of millions of requests per day, and this number grows constantly as we add new locations , integrations , partners to our ecosystem and expand to new geographies. You will be one of the impactful technologists , accountable for Fintech business growth in the International and Enterprise integration team. This is a mission-critical system on which our restaurants rely for their livelihood, so Quality , Reliability and Scalability are paramount. About this roll *: As a QA-II on our team, you will be: Collaborating with Product , Design(UI) and Development stakeholders to understand the requirements. Creating and implementing comprehensive test plans. Conducting and participating in test plan and test strategy reviews. Testing new features and regressions across our suite of hardware and software products.  Create defects for requirement deviations, assign priority and severity and escalate if needed.  Collaborating and assisting the project teams to triage and reproduction of defects, debugging of customer issues,validate fixes and attending sprint ceremonies. Work with other QA engineers and developers to adapt a test automation strategy. Increase Automation test case coverage by developing reusable scripts, brining test efficiency by using automation for release testing.  Actively contribute towards product design and roadmap discussions by pitching ideas from a quality perspective. Keeping current with tools such as Jira, Confluence, TestRail, automation products etc. Do you have the right ingredients*? 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance. Ability to learn and understand complex business logic and find creative ways to test it. Design and deliver test plans for a significant component, set of features, mid-size application, or service.  Have a solid understanding of the test strategies and methodologies used in your technology domain (and how to best apply them). Example API testing using postman, Web Application testing (Desktop, Toast Hardware and Mobile Apps), Automated testing using Selenium , Playwright etc. Possess an appetite for automation and are aware of automation frameworks, methodologies & tools Your test plan, scripts and test case reviews tend to be rapid and uneventful. You provide useful feedback for changes submitted by others.  Your automation test scripts are maintainable and reusable, identify bugs and do not produce false positives.  You make improvements to your team’s testing processes and question the defined set of tests.  You have established good working relationships with team members and peers working on related software.  Commitment to quality, user experience, and using your “get unblocked” attitude for continuous learning and problem solving. Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. Special Sauce* (Extra Ingredients) Strong familiarity with Test Automation frameworks for backend and frontend tech stacks. Understanding and hands on experience with testing of Fintech,Payments Products and services. Our Tech Stack Toast’s products run on a stack that ranges from Guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps(Single Page Applications). Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard. Many of our services use REST and GraphQL architectures. We use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end. title: QA Test Engineer (Pre -Trade Risk)
desc: Why Nasdaq When you work at Nasdaq, you’re working for more open and transparent markets so that more people can access opportunities. Connections can be made, jobs can be created, and communities can thrive. We want all our employees to have access to opportunities, too. What we offer Nasdaq financial platforms run some of the world’s largest exchange markets with billions of trades completed every day. Any problem or software fault can have far-reaching consequences and that is why we work hard on finding even more innovative ways to uphold quality in ever increasingly sophisticated systems. If you have an inquisitive mind and want to work in an environment where we practice experiment-fail-learn to explore how we can automate and further secure quality in our products we believe you will enjoy working with us. You can expect an autonomous but fast-paced work environment where you are recognized for your results and ability to drive things forward. Every day brings many opportunities to learn & grow and rewards with the global impact we build. Our Team Our team, that you will be joining, is working on a crucial part of the systems crafted to maintain the trust of the exchange (and market) by preventing “bad” orders from being entered. This is what we call Pre-Trade-Risk-Analysis. To do this, a sophisticated graph analysis must be completed in microseconds by our system and hence we have very high requirements for our system. What you will do: Test Automation and Quality Engineering Design, develop and maintain automated test suites in our in-house automation framework on Python. Build scalable, maintainable and reusable test automation solutions for backend services, APIs and complex business workflows. Review existing automated coverage and continuously improve automation effectiveness, reliability and maintainability. Integrate and maintain automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Analyze test failures, identify root causes and collaborate with developers to resolve issues efficiently. Test Design and Execution Plan, implement and report tests in qTest, our test orchestration platform. Design comprehensive test scenarios covering positive paths, negative paths, edge cases, boundary conditions and stress scenarios. Apply risk-based testing techniques to ensure critical business flows receive appropriate coverage. Execute exploratory, integration and regression testing when required. Continuous Improvement Use quality metrics and test analytics to identify coverage gaps and improve testing effectiveness. Take ownership of initiatives that improve test coverage, automation efficiency and overall product quality. Partner with developers, business analysts and product owners to ensure quality is built into the product lifecycle. What We Expect: Required Experience A minimum of 4-8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, with significant hands-on test automation experience. Strong proficiency in Python 3 and proven experience developing non-trivial automation frameworks, test suites, scripts or applications. Demonstrated experience building and maintaining automated tests for complex enterprise applications. Strong knowledge of test design techniques, including risk-based testing, boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, negative testing, edge-case testing and exploratory testing. Strong experience working in Agile software development teams. Hands-on experience with Git, GitLab, Jira, Confluence and qTest or similar test management tools. Good experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows. Ability to independently investigate complex issues, identify risks and drive quality improvements. Solid understanding of running systems on a Linux platform. Showing examples of positive impact on both teams and quality processes in previous workplaces. Help us see your passion and dedication to continuous improvement in both yourself and the team you are working with! Nice to Have Basic knowledge of non-functional testing (NFT). Exposure to Capital Market domain – Trading and Pre-Trade Risk. Experience with Selenium or similar UI automation tools. Familiarity with code quality and software composition tools such as SonarQube, Nexus IQ Server, or equivalent. Prior programming experience (Java, Python, bash-scripting, etc.) What Would Be Helpful: A strong automation-first mindset with a proven track record of increasing automated test coverage. The ability to challenge requirements and identify high-risk scenarios before defects reach production. A history of driving measurable improvements in product quality, test efficiency and engineering practices. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence quality across cross-functional. Come as You Are Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.
